How far can Europe’s cheapest and smallest electric cars actually go on a single charge before shutting down completely? Join Mat Watson as he drives 8 affordable EVs until every single one runs completely out of juice!

Starting with the featherweight of the group, the long-range Microlino starts from around £22,870 and weighs in at an ultra-light 535 kg. Powered by a modest 17 hp electric motor, its 15 kWh battery pack promises an official WLTP claimed range of 142 miles.

Next up is the lightweight Dacia Spring Electric 65, which comes in with a budget-friendly starting price of £16,995 and tips the scales at a lean 975 kg. It packs a 65 hp power output and claims an official WLTP driving range of up to 140 miles on a full charge.

title: I drove the cheapest new EVs until THEY DIED!
